title: Video Observation finalisation stability repair
details: Fixes the final-AC Video Observation freeze that could leave Milos on Saving clip with a black camera preview
Preserves native MediaRecorder dataavailable then stop ordering instead of declaring a stop while the recorder is still active
Recovers a genuinely missing stop event only after the recorder has become inactive, with a bounded track-stop fallback for stuck devices
Saves the live observation WebM without running the synchronous duration rewrite before persistence, avoiding the main-thread lock seen during finalisation
Keeps the existing Milos observation, review, QR, evidence and local learner data formats unchanged
